summary: First test run for kik auction house. Backend (8/8 pytest cases) and frontend (public pages, admin login + dashboard CRUD) work end-to-end. Found minor UX/code-review issues but no blocking bugs.

minor.issue: Returns 403 (HTTPBearer default) instead of 401 when no token sent. Acceptable but inconsistent with spec wording 'returns 401'.

ui_bugs.issue: Wrong-credentials error not visible via .error/[class*=error]/[role=alert] selectors. User stays on /admin/login but no inline error message rendered (or it is rendered without an error class). Hard for a user to know login failed.
data-testid='newsletter-status' element was not visible after submit in our run (status text did not appear). Backend dedup works, but UI confirmation may not be shown reliably.
Uses native browser datetime-local picker instead of a shadcn Calendar / styled component. Looks inconsistent with brutalist design system.
Page <title> is 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of branded 'kik' on every route.

issues: Browser tab title is generic 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — should be 'kik. — auction house' or similar.

action_items:
Render visible inline error on /admin/login when login fails (e.g.
Invalid credentials
).
Verify newsletter-status visibly appears after subscribe; consider toast or always-visible status block.
Replace native datetime-local input with shadcn Calendar/DateTimePicker for design consistency.
Set <title> in index.html to 'kik. — nomadic auction house' (or use react-helmet).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 23-30: uses os.environ['KEY'] (KeyError on startup if missing) — acceptable fail-fast, but JWT_SECRET not validated for length.
Tab key in AdminDashboard.jsx is 'contact' but spec/README says 'Messages'. Consider renaming label to 'messages' for clarity.
newsletter dedup returns 200 with same record (good), but when a duplicate email is sent with a different language, the language is NOT updated — possible business intent issue.
admin_delete_auction cascades to lots — good, but no transactional guarantee (acceptable for MVP).
CORS allow_origins falls back to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin; ensure CORS_ORIGINS env is set in deploy.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_-prefixed artists/auctions/lots/newsletter via pytest. No leftover test data expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reuse it. Admin dashboard tab keys are: auctions, lots, artists, newsletter, contact (NOT 'messages'). Confirmation testids: newsletter-status, contact-status. Admin login error UI is currently silent — keep an eye on it.
